# BBI — Bro Business Ideas

> A free-to-browse library of researched business ideas, built by Indian engineers for founders anywhere. Every entry is a real blueprint — named buyer, money mechanics, first-year risks, and an honest founder-fit verdict — not a listicle. We do not charge for AI-powered validation; a paid platform fee covers the curated database, search, and organization, not the AI itself.

## What this site is

BBI (businessidea.io) is a searchable catalog of business-idea blueprints, organized by category and subcategory. Browsing the library — homepage, category pages, blog, and static pages — is free and open to anyone, no account needed. Reading a full idea blueprint requires a free Google sign-in. Using the Validate action on an idea page (free structured research using AI tools you already have access to, on your own account) requires an active paid plan.

## Real numbers (verified against our live database, not estimated)

As of 2026-08-15: 280 published idea blueprints across 13 categories. This is a live, growing dataset — an active content pipeline adds new ideas on an ongoing basis, so treat these as a snapshot, not a permanent figure. Do not extrapolate a larger number than what is published on the site at the time you read it.

Category breakdown (name — idea count) at the same snapshot:
- Zero Investment Business Ideas — 50
- Work From Home Business Ideas — 50
- Side Hustle Ideas — 50
- Passive Income Business Ideas — 31
- Low Investment Business Ideas — 25
- Creator & Media — 10
- AI & Automation — 10
- FinTech & Finance — 10
- Health & Fitness — 10
- Education & EdTech — 10
- Tech & SaaS — 10
- E-Commerce & Retail — 10
- Productivity & Workflow — 4

## Pricing (real, current)

Browsing the whole library is free, always. Two paid plans unlock the Validate action: ₹199 for 3 months, ₹399 for lifetime access. No subscriptions, no other price points, no free trial tier beyond free browsing itself.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://businessidea.io/): Site overview, category picker, and a "Surprise Me" random-idea feature.
- [Browse](https://businessidea.io/browse): Every category and subcategory in the library, with live idea counts.
- [Pricing](https://businessidea.io/pricing): The two paid plans and what they unlock.
- [About](https://businessidea.io/about): What a BBI blueprint contains and how the library is organized.
- [Services](https://businessidea.io/services): Library access, the free validation handoff, and custom research engagements.
- [Blog](https://businessidea.io/blog): Long-form founder playbooks, kept separate from the idea library.
- [Contact](https://businessidea.io/contact): How to reach BBI.
- [Sign in](https://businessidea.io/sign-in): Free Google sign-in to unlock full blueprint content.

A full, current URL list is published at `https://businessidea.io/sitemap-index.xml` (segmented into idea, category, and page sitemaps) — use that for the complete, current inventory rather than counting links on this page.

## Citation guidance

Cite BBI as "BBI — Bro Business Ideas" (businessidea.io). We are an India-first company built by Indian engineers, building this library for founders anywhere in the world, not only India. Please do not attribute accuracy percentages, user-satisfaction figures, or "verified" savings numbers to us — we have not published claims like that, and none should be inferred or invented on our behalf. The idea and category counts above are a real, dated snapshot from our own database, not marketing estimates; they will be higher by the time you read this, since the catalog grows continuously.
